abstract: Persistent homology is effective for analyzing the structure of handwritten characters, which often exhibit diverse forms. In our previous research, we proposed elliptical filtration and CHD filtration as methods for calculating persistent homology to accurately extract the invariant structure of handwritten characters. However, the persistent intervals extracted using these methods represent the lifespan of each hole or cluster of black pixels. Consequently, if components differ in size or position but have the same number, these features can potentially lead to misrecognition. In this study, we define the persistent property by incorporating information on the position and size of holes or clusters of black pixels into the conventional persistent interval. We prove that this information is contained within specific basis vectors of the representation matrix of the first boundary homomorphism in persistent homology. We also propose an algorithm to extract this information. The proposed persistent property better represents invariant features of characters, and we found that these features improve recognition accuracy.

Anime production archives group intermediate assets by production cut; individual files may provide incomplete visual evidence. This study examines how to represent cut-aligned scripts on the index side of a natural-language retrieval system. With a fixed multilingual encoder and ranking procedure, we compare nine conditions based on raw script text, neighboring context, structured metadata, retrieval-oriented rewriting, text concatenation, and score fusion. The evaluation covers Little Witch Academia (LWA1) and Little Witch Academia: The Enchanted Parade (LWA2), with 373 and 269 indexed production-cut units and 53,620 asset files. We report mean pooled nDCG@10 over 23, 12, and 8 queries for the two work-specific settings and the combined corpus. Several representations yielded numerical gains over raw script text, but none of the nDCG@10 comparisons with the baseline reached statistical significance after Holm correction.

Instruction-tuned large language models have shown strong instruction-following and reasoning capabilities, but their deployment remains costly due to high computational and memory requirements. To improve the practicality of smaller language models, this work investigates parameter-efficient knowledge distillation for transferring instruction-following capability from an 8B teacher model to a 3B student model. Specifically, we investigate a training framework that combines supervised fine-tuning, logits-based knowledge distillation, and DoRA-based parameter-efficient adaptation. To support training, we construct a 20k-sample instruction-style corpus, named Curated Instruction Mixture 20K (CIM-20K), by combining and filtering samples from WizardLM, Magpie-Pro, and ShareGPT. We refer to the resulting distilled 3B student as DoRA-KD-3B and evaluate it against Llama-3.2-3B, DoRA-3B, and LoRA-KD-3B, together with Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct and the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct teacher as instruction-tuned reference models. Across three random seeds, DoRA-KD-3B achieves mean scores of 3.787 on MT-Bench, 0.474 on ARC-C, 0.293 on GSM8K, 0.552 on MMLU, and 0.456 on TruthfulQA, exceeding the base Llama-3.2-3B model on all five aggregate benchmarks. Among the trained non-instruction-tuned 3B models, DoRA-KD-3B achieves the highest mean scores on MT-Bench, ARC-C, MMLU, and TruthfulQA, while DoRA-3B achieves the highest mean score on GSM8K. Overall, the results suggest that logits-based distillation can complement DoRA-based adaptation, although its benefit depends on the evaluation task.

Software-Defined Networking (SDN) centralizes control-plane intelligence, exposing it to both volumetric DDoS floods and stealthy, low-rate poisoning attacks. Existing defenses address these threats in isolation---volume-based classifiers miss covert low-rate patterns, while purely entropy-based methods suffer elevated false positives---and both lack the semantic contextual awareness needed to reliably distinguish benign fluctuations from adversarial behavior. To address these limitations, we propose GuardianNet, an LLM-assisted multi-agent framework deployed within a Mininet and Ryu SDN testbed. Our system comprises a hierarchical three-agent architecture: (1) a Statistical Agent employing a K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) classifier for instantaneous volumetric screening; (2) an Entropy Agent that computes Shannon Entropy over the packet-delta sequence of each flow to detect the mechanical regularity characteristic of low-rate injection; and (3) a Reasoning Supervisor powered by a locally deployed open-source Large Language Model (Llama-3.1). By converting raw telemetry and entropy signals into structured natural-language contexts, the LLM supervisor enables reasoning over attack semantics that numerical classifiers cannot capture. Compared against four established baselines---KNN, Random Forest, LSTM, and an Entropy Only detector---GuardianNet attains 90.0\% accuracy with a 0.0\% FPR. The ablation study across six agent configurations shows that rule-based fusion of the two statistical agents reaches 68.1\% accuracy with a 68.2\% false positive rate (FPR), whereas adding the LLM supervisor raises accuracy to 83.2\% and eliminates false positives entirely.

Learned atmospheric compressors are usually assessed by aggregate distortion, which does not reveal how much residual error remains predictable from decoded fields. We apply a fixed 1.65\,M-parameter U-Net to CRA5 reconstructions over CONUS without adding per-frame bits. On the full 2018 test year, mean normalised RMSE decreases by 25.8\% over 19 directly represented FourCastNet variables (95\% temporal block-bootstrap interval [25.32, 26.18]\%). On the complete 2022 year outside CRA5's published training window, the same frozen checkpoint and normalisation give a 26.4\% reduction [25.90, 26.93]\%, without fine-tuning. Near-surface versus upper-air gains are 32.2\% versus 3.5\% in 2018 and 32.8\% versus 3.6\% in 2022. A mean-rate-matched MPCA-only control has a smaller near/upper gain ratio, while additional MPCA+PCA controls are explicitly non-matched. A parameter-matched dilation ablation retains a roughly eightfold split and concentrated gradient sensitivity. Using ERA5 orography and land--sea masks, western-land correction gains increase from 18.1\% to 36.9\% between the lowest and highest terrain-roughness deciles, while corrected errors remain larger on rough ground. Elevation-stratified comparisons support an association but do not isolate a terrain mechanism. These results measure model-relative predictability; terrain causality, corrector architecture effects, and broader distribution-shift robustness remain open. Shared weights and inference add deployment costs.

abstract: Maintaining road infrastructure imposes critical challenges, such as road monitoring, condition assessment, and targeted fixes. Manual road surveillance is costly and unsuitable for long-term sustainable development, which necessitates automation of the process. Road Damage Detection (RDD) is one of the most crucial applications of Computer Vision. As automated detection requires the integration of the Internet of Things (IoT) with intelligent detectors, implementing lightweight detection methods is crucial. Apart from the architectural design, training data plays a crucial role, which necessitates a careful data preparation pipeline to overcome common issues such as class imbalance. In this study, we investigate various methods to overcome this issue with a controlled experimental setup. We employ the challenging, severely imbalanced multi-country N-RDD2024 dataset to perform data-centric analysis. Our comparison includes three YOLOv8 (small, medium, and large) and three YOLOv11 (small, medium, and large) detector backbones trained using four different data-class modes (original, grouped, frequency-filtered, and priority) to overcome class imbalance and four training and inference strategies (standard training, Test-Time Augmentation, localization-focused, and class-weighted training) to analyze the role of optimization. The experimental results reveal that the data-class design was the primary driver of performance improvement, where grouped and frequency-filtered aggregations led to the highest performance regardless of the backbone. The analysis also includes investigating various image resolutions, as well as inference latency and efficiency metrics. This work aims to contribute to efficient RDD development under resource-constrained environments, making the detectors suitable for edge deployment and real-time inference.

Unsupervised Environment Design (UED) aims to promote generalization by automating the generation of a curriculum of environments for training control policies, maximizing the learning utility tailored to the current policy's capabilities. Replay-based UED methods prioritize environments sampled from a random generator, while learning-based UED methods generate environments via a learned generator. However, for control tasks with complex environment generation spaces, randomly generated environments can become overly complex. In addition, learning-based methods often rely either on a predefined dataset, which may not be available, or on reinforcement learning, which can be unstable. In this work, to address these challenges, we investigate whether an off-the-shelf Vision-Language Model (VLM) can serve as an effective environment curriculum generator for UED because a VLM can leverage its prior knowledge of real-world distributions to constrain environment generation for replay-based methods and serve as a training-free alternative. Experimental results demonstrate that a VLM, when properly prompted, serves as a promising generator that outperforms existing UED baselines. Furthermore, we show that integrating a complementary replay-based method can further improve generalization performance.

This RtD-informed retrospective case analysis examines how creative requirements were represented and reformulated while producing a 121-second AI-generated video comprising ten interdependent narrative units. Generation histories for S01–S10 were retained in Seedance 2.0, but coverage did not imply equal claim-level support. The analysis distinguishes event organization from requirement decomposition, maps object–relation and state–process configurations, and assesses input specification, output compliance, and subsequent action separately. Evidence is classified by support level: paired input–output (Vp), ordered revision-chain (Vc), summary-supported (S), or conflict-flagged (C). S05 documents an unmet fivefold scale requirement and a subsequent ordered revision to a tenfold scale; S08 and S09 provide additional chains. Evidence varies across four reformulation codes: process elaboration and relational-constraint change are chain-supported, event segmentation occurs in S09, and reference reconfiguration remains unverified. The framework suggests preliminary intention checks for future agentic creative systems without evaluating autonomous behavior, independently validating coding, or testing causal revision effects.

UAV-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) for LowAltitude Wireless Networks (LAWN) face three major obstacles that undermine conventional Federated Learning (FL): non-independent and identically distributed (Non-IID) data, class imbalance, and communication constraints. To address them, we present a robust three-tier Hierarchical Federated Learning (HFL) framework based on a “Client– Aggregator–Cloud” architecture. The framework combines FedProx, Server EMA, dynamic class weighting, and cloud-based knowledge distillation with Prototype Learning. Evaluations on the CICIDS2017 dataset, including systematic ablation studies and tests under Label Flipping and Model Poisoning threats, show that the proposed framework reaches an F1-score of 0.9753 and substantially surpasses the FedAvg baseline in both accuracy and convergence speed. The resulting hierarchical security solution is secure, communication-efficient, and deployable in LAWNs. The source code is available in the project repository.

This study compared and analyzed the humor generated by an LLM and humans in the context of Ogiri. Ogiri is a Japanese comedy format in which participants improvise short responses to a given theme, competing based on the unexpectedness and humor of their ideas. Re-sponses often involve deviations from context and wordplay, requiring spontaneous creativity. In recent years, advancements in generative AI technology have made sophisticated language generation possible. How-ever, it remains unclear whether LLMs possess the same capabilities as humans when it comes to generating humor that requires cultural con-text and spontaneous creativity, as seen in Ogiri. Therefore, this study conducted a subjective evaluation experiment with 24 participants, us-ing responses generated by ChatGPT (an LLM) and response data from comedians on the Ogiri TV Show for the same themes. In the experi-ment, responses from the LLM and humans were presented randomly, and participants were asked to rate the humor of each response on a 7-point Likert scale ranging from 0 to 6. In total, we selected 10 themes and prepared 20 responses for each theme, consisting of 10 responses generated by the LLM and 10 responses created by humans, resulting in 200 responses evaluated by the participants. The results showed that, on average, human responses significantly outperformed LLM-generated re-sponses. Analysis of the responses revealed that humans excelled in the leaps of logic and surprise characteristic of Ogiri. On the other hand, instances were observed where the LLM received higher ratings than humans for certain themes. Analysis revealed that the LLM generated responses containing logical and concrete explanations, suggesting that ease of understanding contributed to the higher humor ratings. In con-trast, the short responses provided by humans were diﬃcult to under-stand in context when presented as text alone. The results of this study indicate that while the LLM excels at contextual coherence and explana- tory ability, humans currently hold the advantage in Ogiri, suggesting that LLMs have the potential to surpass humans under specific condi-tions.

Natural-language UAV missions combine terrain preferences with ordered visits and surveys. We present a vision-language agent that constructs semantic cost maps and route anchors, evaluates A* paths, and revises its decisions through visual feedback. In 27 missions with three repetitions per method, it returns all 81 routes and achieves a mean model-judged checklist violation rate of 14.7%, versus 45.8% for an OVerSeeC implementation. The system integrates semantic terrain modeling, ordered route planning, and visual revision in a unified workflow for compositional aerial missions.

abstract: 現有網球 AI 教練系統多以專家模板之相似度作為回饋依據，難以說明動作差異與擊球結果之關聯，其建議之正確性亦未被驗證。本研究提出一套基於姿態估計之個人化網球教練系統驗證架構，以多視角攝影擷取人體關節點、球拍與球體軌跡，計算擊球瞬間之拍面角度、揮拍速度、擊球點位置、肩髖分離角與重心轉移量等多維揮拍特徵，並以過網高度與落點區域定義擊球是否達成目標。系統以特徵重要性辨識關鍵因子，並從揮拍條件相近之成功擊球產生量化修正建議，再以混淆矩陣評估建議之準確度。驗證分為兩階段：先以預試檢驗姿態估計與特徵之可靠性；再以 10 至 15 位初學者之發球機正手直線擊球（每人 50 球），以實際落點正反向檢驗建議之正確性，並與基準方法比較。本文完成架構與協議之設計，正式資料收集尚未執行。

abstract: 少樣本類別增量學習 (Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning, FSCIL) 的核心目標，是在每個新類別僅有少量樣本的條件下持續學習，同時維持對舊類別的辨識能力，因此同時面臨災難性遺忘與少樣本過擬合。現有方法多以固定策略處理不同資料集，較少考量資料特性在特徵空間幾何上的差異。本研究借用軟體工程的需求分析思維，以 SEC-Prompt 為提示學習基底，並引入凍結的 CLIP 文字編碼器作為跨模態語義錨點，針對 CIFAR-100 的高雜訊與低解析度、CUB-200 的細粒度極端相似性，以及 ImageNet-R 的跨領域風格變異，分別設計信心感知邊界語義對齊模組 (CAM-SAC)、跨模態柔性分佈蒸餾模組 (CM-SDD) 與跨模態同步混合語義對齊 (Mixup-SAC)。標準 5-shot 實驗中，本研究在三個資料集皆取得最高平均準確率 (AAvg)，且相較基線 SEC-Prompt，準確率下降幅度 (PD) 分別降低 1.54、0.42 與 1.49 個百分點。跨資料集消融中，CIFAR-100 於方法錯置時 PD 最高達專屬方法的 4.6 倍。

長期壓力會危害身心健康，因此建立可靠且可泛化的自動壓力辨識系統已成為情感運算的重要課題。然而，既有研究常未嚴格隔離受試者，且在有限資料下，手工特徵、深度序列模型、多模態融合與集成學習之相對效益仍缺乏一致比較。本研究使用同步蒐集生理訊號、影像與語音之 StressID 資料集，採用五折受試者分層群組交叉驗證（Subject-wise Stratified Group K-Fold, SGKF），並以巢狀模型選擇確保外層測試受試者不參與超參數或投票權重調整。實驗系統性比較手工特徵、ResNet-50 與 Wav2Vec 2.0 表徵、LSTM、Transformer-BiLSTM、特徵層與決策層融合，以及多種集成方法。結果顯示，基於原始 500 Hz 訊號萃取之生理手工特徵整體最佳：二元壓力辨識使用 ExtraTrees 的加權 F1 為 0.699、平衡準確率為 0.704；三分類情感辨識使用加權軟投票的加權 F1 為 0.513。多模態 Transformer-BiLSTM 於二元任務達 0.652，仍未超越生理集成模型。5、25、50 與 100 Hz 的控制式消融亦顯示，提高輸入取樣率並未改善生理 LSTM。研究結果說明，在受試者獨立且資料有限的條件下，領域知識導向的生理表徵與穩健集成學習，比單純增加時間解析度、模態數量或模型複雜度更具效益。

This work presents a preliminary weed stem candidate localization method for RealSense-assisted laser weeding. Instead of using full polygon segmentation masks, the proposed approach uses point-level annotations placed near visible weed stem centers. The annotated points are converted into Gaussian heatmaps and used to fine-tune a U-Net-based model for stem candidate prediction. A manually prepared dataset containing 114 cropped field images and 974 weed-stem point labels was used. The data were split into 79 training images, 17 validation images, and 18 test images. On the 18 test images, an exploratory threshold of 0.85 produced 137 matched points from 155 ground-truth stem points, with 25 false positives and 18 missed points. The precision, recall, and F1-score were 0.8457, 0.8839, and 0.8644, respectively, with a mean localization error of 3.7629 pixels on a 512-pixel scale. Preliminary RealSense RGB camera experiments using printed weed images demonstrated live stem-candidate localization. However, false detections on crop or non-target plants remain a limitation. Future work will focus on crop-weed filtering, height-aware RealSense calibration, and laser shooting efficiency tests on weeds with different heights.

FreshKG is evaluated as a mission-level supervisor for UAV routes whose corridor permissions can age, arrive late, or conflict across sources. Experiments in gym-pybullet-drones and safe-control-gym comprise 30,000 mission episodes and 2,000 fixed-reference tests, with 100 paired seeds per condition. With the safe-control-gym PID controller, FreshKG safely completes 464/600 missions, compared with 107/600 for LatestArrival; the paired improvement is 59.5 percentage points (95% cluster-bootstrap CI, 57.7-61.2). An equal-information table implementation and the graph implementation make identical supervisory decisions, indicating that the gain arises from the information rules rather than graph representation alone. We repeat the mission study with PID, LQR, MPC, and six fixed PPO/SAC residual checkpoints, and use separate fixed-reference trials to characterize tracking and attitude behavior. Ablations isolate observation order, expiry, and source filtering, while recorded failures show where replanning is insufficient. The evidence is limited to simulation and supports a mission-supervision claim, not a new flight controller or formal safety guarantee.

abstract: This paper presents a skeleton-based Taiwanese Sign Language (TSL) recognition and sentence reconstruction system. MediaPipe Holistic landmarks are normalized, cropped by wrist motion, and resampled to 30 frames. A task-specific hierarchy routes inputs to five motion families and activates a specialist whose features match the observed motion structure. On a video-level 80/20 split, the 124-dimensional Uni-LSTM with temporal attention achieves 99.42% gatekeeper accuracy, while specialist accuracies are 81.40%, 100.00%, 92.40%, 91.60%, and 95.80% on 79 labels and 398 videos. These are component results; the approximately 91.7% cascade value is an independence-based estimate rather than a measured end-to-end accuracy. A local language reconstruction module uses seven TSL-oriented few-shot patterns and a three-turn LangChain memory to reconstruct fragmented lexical predictions into Chinese sentences. The language results are prototype-scale qualitative evidence, and signer-independent testing, controlled baselines, sentencelevel metrics, human evaluation, and full-pipeline latency remain future work. All data processing and document preparation for this study were performed locally.

Real-time visual surveillance on unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is severely constrained by onboard battery storage and thermal dissipation limits, rendering continuous 30 FPS deep neural network (DNN) forward passes unsustainable. Conventional background subtraction fails catastrophically in aerial video due to 6-DoF camera ego-motion. In this paper, we propose an Ego-Motion Compensated Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Difference (ASTD) gating architecture for energy-efficient edge detection. ASTD dynamically neutralizes drone flight motion via real-time RANSAC homography alignment and scale-invariant spatial filtering, serving as an intelligent compute gate that awakens downstream DNN detectors only upon genuine dynamic events. Evaluated on a continuous 1,821-frame 1080P real-world construction flight sequence, ASTD successfully skips 97.91% of redundant background frames at an ultra-low edge latency of 22.04 ms (45.37 FPS). ASTD slashes weighted per-frame inference latency by 91.0% (serving as an effective proxy for edge computational energy reduction) while achieving 100% event recall across all active machinery, demonstrating exceptional power efficiency for persistent autonomous UAV surveillance.

abstract: 現有將 VLM 應用於工業異常檢測的研究多偏重邏輯性異常，較少顧及結構性異常。本研究透過資料庫式異常檢測與 VLM 的結合來完善兩類異常的偵測平衡：PatchCore 將區域異常分數以文字提供給 VLM，VLM 回答邏輯性與結構性問題集後評分，最後整合兩者的分數判斷是否異常。我們發現僅用邏輯性問題集時，VLM 在結構異常上與 PatchCore 的貼合度不足，因此加入了結構性問題集讓 VLM 回答更多結構性異常原因；而實驗中也發現 VLM 擁有最終判定權時會否決 PatchCore 的資訊，因此改採等權重分數融合。本架構不需訓練模型參數，在 MVTec LOCO-AD 上達到 logical F1-max 0.870、logical AUROC 0.916、structural AUROC 0.917 與 overall AUROC 0.915，並能輸出自然語言的異常原因說明。

Existing VLM-based work on industrial anomaly detection focuses mainly on logical anomalies and pays less attention to structural ones. We balance the two by combining database-based anomaly detection with a VLM: PatchCore supplies regional anomaly scores to the VLM as text, the VLM answers a logical and a structural question set and returns scores, and the two scores are fused to decide whether an image is anomalous. We found that with logical questions alone the VLM aligned poorly with PatchCore on structural anomalies, so we added a structural question set that lets the VLM report more structural causes; we also found that the VLM overrides PatchCore when given final decision authority, so we fuse the scores with equal weights. The framework trains no model parameters. On MVTec LOCO-AD it achieves a logical F1-max of 0.870, logical AUROC of 0.916, structural AUROC of 0.917, and overall AUROC of 0.915, with natural-language explanations of detected anomalies.

abstract: 語言模型可透過模型上下文協定（Model Context Protocol, MCP）調用外部工具，但通過身分與角色授權，並不代表每次操作都符合使用者原有的行為脈絡。研究原型在 MCP 工具呼叫包裝層建立事件：呼叫前取得使用者、工作階段、工具、時間與工作流程等脈絡，呼叫後補入目的地類別及執行狀態，再選取分析所需欄位形成研究資料；完整提示詞、憑證、敏感工具參數及完整輸出不納入本文分析資料。固定合成測試集共 290 筆事件，工作流程感知規則模型的 Recall、Precision、F1 與 FPR 分別為 0.724、0.974、0.831 與 0.050，ROC-AUC 及 PR-AUC 分別為 0.986 與 0.994。在同一測試集的回溯消融中，加入工作流程脈絡欄位後，F1 由 0.794 增至 0.831。結果顯示，依 MCP 工具呼叫結構形成的操作脈絡可轉換為可追溯的使用者行為資料，並用來辨識時間、工具、目的地與工作流程等偏離。所有結果均來自合成資料，尚不能視為真實企業環境的異常偵測成效；行為分數也不直接改變既有授權決策或工具執行結果。

abstract: 黑色素瘤資料高度不平衡，且既有多模態研究常採不同模型與實驗設定，難以釐清各架構元件的實際影響。本研究以 ISIC 2020 資料集進行四階段比較，依序評估影像特徵提取器、臨床資料模型、融合策略與損失函數，並以惡性類別 Recall 與 F1-score 為重點。最終架構（EfficientNet + MLP + Ori-concat + Focal Loss）於驗證集達 ROC-AUC 0.9108、Accuracy 0.9470、惡性 Recall 0.5043 與 F1-score 0.2516，其惡性 Recall 高於影像單模態 (0.0342)，Precision (0.1676) 則在 Recall 相近下高於僅用臨床資料之模型 (0.0498)。結果顯示，在本實驗設定下，較複雜的融合機制未提升惡性檢出，而多模態資訊與 Focal Loss 有助於改善極度不平衡情境下的少數類別辨識。

abstract: 本研究針對海鱺種魚外觀性徵不易由岸上觀察之問題，自行蒐集養殖場水下影像並進行人工標註，建立海鱺種魚性徵成熟度資料集，提出以腹部骨架與條紋幾何特徵為基礎的影像分析方法。系統以 YOLOR 定位魚體並選取側面影像，再以重新訓練之 MobileNet v1 作為特徵擷取網路，利用自建海鱺關鍵點資料微調 OpenPose，預測依養殖專家經驗定義之性徵位置與腹部骨架，透過主成分分析量化條紋特徵長度，將條紋與腹部長度比例 R 及腹部角度 D 輸入 FHRCNN，完成 0 至 3 期外觀性徵分類。研究貢獻包括自建性徵成熟度資料集、海鱺專用關鍵點與骨架設計、OpenPose 任務微調、腹部與條紋幾何表示，以及水下魚體偵測至性徵分期之流程整合。成熟度分類資料包含訓練 1,200 筆、驗證 150 筆及測試 150 筆，依十次實驗結果計算，FHRCNN 平均測試準確率為 74.30%，線性 SVM 平均測試準確率為 74.10%。本研究將養殖人員依經驗觀察的腹部與條紋特徵轉換為量化資料，建立海鱺種魚外觀性徵分期之影像分析基礎。

組合料號圖，又稱為料號說明列表，常存在於電子零件規格書中表示一組相似零件料號的基本特性，而各廠商組合料號圖也常具有不同的樣式，甚至同一家廠商就可能有多種組合料號表示。通常一份組合料號圖上至少會含有下列三部分的資料：樣板、特性、及屬性值(含說明)，而這三個部分的資料內容常會是電子設計自動化公司之工程師所需要參考的資料。而組合料號的形式眾多，而且都是以圖形形式儲存，而不是簡單的以表格儲存，因此更增添了處理時的困難度。由於一份PDF電子規格書可能包含很多頁，因此我們先結合關鍵字判斷及物件偵測的技術找出組合料號圖所在的頁數及該圖在所找到頁數的位置，並把它切割出來。接著我們利用深度學習的方法去擷取一組合料號圖的樣板、特性、及屬性值(含說明)區塊，並使用傳統圖形識別的方法找出組合料號圖的特徵如有無方框、線條方向等精確地框定並配對子名稱與其對應的屬性值以獲得更準確的結果。接下來，我們再運用光學文字辨識技術對所割出來的樣板、特性、及屬性值(含說明)區塊作內容辨識，並利用正規表達式以及黑白名單策略將其分類為子名稱、屬性、值和值集合。實驗顯示不受OCR影響時準確率可達到87%。

abstract: Melody–accompaniment separation in solo piano audio requires distinguishing musical roles that share timbre and overlapping spectra. We evaluated two independent spectral two-dimensional (2D) U-Nets with complementary-source masking and mixture-phase reconstruction, trained on piano audio rendered from Classical MIDI files. A composite objective combined spectral L1, multi-scale pooling, waveform scale-invariant signal-to-distortion ratio (SI-SDR), and similarity losses. On 80 held-out test pieces, mean SI-SDR was 8.4 dB for melody and 10.7 dB for accompaniment. In a supplementary re-rendering test with two alternative SoundFonts, mean SI-SDR improvement over the input mixture remained positive, although scores decreased. An exploratory listening study with 126 respondents detected differences among accompaniment excerpts but no significant differences among melody outputs. The findings are limited to synthesized audio; controlled model comparisons, loss ablations, and evaluation on real recordings remain necessary.

abstract: Patient-level weak supervision reduces frame-level annotation in gastroscopy but propagates each patient's diagnosis to many nondiagnostic images. We compared eight Vision Transformer backbones for Helicobacter pylori prediction under fine-grained image-level and patient-level weak supervision. Models were developed with five-fold patient-level cross-validation in 327 patients and evaluated in an independent temporal cohort of 97 patients. Under fine-grained supervision, all backbones achieved AUROCs of 92.71%-94.11%. Under weak supervision, seven retained 91.92%-93.77%, whereas native DINOv2 ViT-B/14 declined to 78.29% ± 17.92%. Gastrointestinal continuation self-supervision on 480,000 to 4.8 million GastroNet-5M images restored AUROC to 91.64%-93.25%. The 480,000-image, 50,000-step configuration reached 92.92% ± 0.50%, only 0.33 percentage points below the highest mean. Intermediate supervised fine-tuning on 10,662 HyperKvasir images raised native DINOv2 ViT-B/14 AUROC to 91.76% ± 0.97% but changed already robust backbones little. Patient-level weak supervision therefore exposes representation-specific transfer instability. Effective domain adaptation was possible with sub-million-scale unlabeled data or a smaller labeled gastrointestinal task, but its benefit depended on the starting representation.

心臟電腦斷層可提供高解析度之三維心臟結構資訊，但人工逐層標註心肌、瓣膜與鈣化區域耗時且高度仰賴專業經驗。本研究目的為初探以 nnU-Net v2 建立心臟 CT 多類別自動分割流程，採 3D Full Resolution 組態與五折交叉驗證進行 1000 epochs 訓練。訓練資料共 50 例，每折使用 40 例訓練與 10 例驗證；五折 Mean Validation Dice 分別為 0.5615、0.5562、0.5640、0.5619 與 0.5627，平均為 0.5613。另以五折集成模型對 50 例具參考標準標註之測試影像進行評估，心肌、瓣膜 與 鈣化之 Dice 分別為 0.9226±0.0144、0.7388±0.0424 與 0.0000±0.0000，三類別平均 Dice 為 0.5538。進一步分析發現 calcium 僅出現在 10 例測試資料中，且前景體素數遠少於 muscle 與 valve，模型未預測出任何 calcium voxel，顯示極端類別不平衡仍是本資料集之主要挑戰。研究結果說明 nnU-Net 對心肌與瓣膜具有良好分割能力，但鈣化區域仍需透過資料增補、損失函數調整或取樣策略改善。

abstract: Companies listed in Taiwan publish each sustainability indicator twice: in a narrative report, and as a structured record, on the exchange's ESG platform, that declares the figure's boundary. Given a report passage and a filing record for one indicator, a system answers Supported, Contradicted, NotComparable (not shown to be the same quantity) or NotApplicable (not filed); it must thus check whether two figures denote the same quantity, not merely whether their digits agree. We build a controlled diagnostic benchmark whose gold comes from the filings, fixed text rules and a ledger of injected changes, with no human or model judgement: 3,483 digit-exact anchors from 885 companies yield 3,000 perturbed items, and a 95-item panel substitutes whole records that keep their own indicator label. We run one reasoning model, kimi-k2.7-code (with kimi-k3, of the same provider, on the panel), in four configurations, from page text to an adversarial four-role pipeline. On the 88 items all four answered, admissible accuracy, which credits every verdict the task rules allow, ranges from 0.784 (pipeline) to 0.886. Substituted values are rarely affirmed (2 of 160 verdicts), and with neighbouring pages the model rejects a record that declares another indicator in 36 of 37 cases; the pipeline affirms 12 of 35. Of 16 unperturbed controls that a system rejected, five reveal a unit, definition or boundary mismatch that digit-exact anchoring had accepted: the digit matching we set out to detect was in our own construction.

Modern generative models produce synthetic imagery nearly indistinguishable from real photographs. While these capabilities enable applications in creative content generation, they also introduce significant security and societal risks. This motivates the development of reliable methods for detecting AI-generated image. However, existing forensic detectors exploit a single class of artifact and fails outside its designated realm. A single detector that is trained to exploit artifacts associated with one generation paradigm may become a bottleneck when evaluated on another. In this paper, we present **FUSE** (Fused Unified Synthetic-image Ensemble), which fuses five complementary channels (UnivFD, NPR, FreqNet, and two DIRE variants) with a LightGBM meta-classifier that both combines and measures each channel's contribution. FUSE exposes a deployable scoring mechanism, a weighted score and a category OR-gate, so that channels can cover one another's individual failures. In the out-of-distribution evaluation on an unseen AI-generated versus real artwork domain, two fusion variants of FUSE ($0.550$ in weighted score and $0.580$ in OR-gate maximum) outperform the LightGBM meta-ensemble ($0.475$) in AUC. As for in-distribution and in-family benchmarks, FUSE's deployed weighted score reaches $0.94$--$1.00$ AUC across seven splits. An extended robustness study across all five channels shows that FUSE holds $0.985$ AUC under severe Gaussian blur ($\sigma{=}3$), where the semantic channel alone falls to $0.830$.

Echo embeddings extract high-quality text embeddings from decoder-only LLMs by feeding the input twice and pooling over the repeated segment, requiring no training. We find, however, that this construction amplifies length collapse, the tendency of long-text embeddings to concentrate in a narrow region of the representation space regardless of semantic content. Our analysis traces the amplification to two structural properties of the echo construction. Pooling from the later segment places the pooled tokens at positions with greater smoothing capacity, and the echo-to-echo attention path forms a recursive smoothing loop in which the pooled segment repeatedly averages its own already-smoothed representations. We propose Direction Echo, a training-free method that blocks echo-to-echo attention with an additive mask, so that each echo token reads only the original input. This severs the recursive smoothing loop, mitigating the amplified collapse. On the Massive Text Embeddings Benchmark (MTEB) with Mistral-7B-Instruct, Direction Echo outperforms echo embeddings by 4.33 points on average, with a gain of 11.01 points on retrieval tasks, which typically involve longer inputs.

Evaluating video games is highly subjective, and understanding player perspectives requires analyzing both internal game mechanics and external contexts. Existing research on game reviews often overlooks how multi-layered contexts, such as historical release eras and age ratings, dynamically influence player priorities. To address this gap, this study constructs a comprehensive dataset linking game metadata—including genres, release dates, and age ratings—with 121,787 user reviews across 8,197 video games. Utilizing traditional dependency parsing for transparency, we extract target features (subjects) and their associated evaluation content (predicates) to systematically analyze what players focus on and how they express their evaluations. Our analysis revealed that while fundamental features like "enemy'' and "difficulty'' are universally evaluated across all genres, specific genres heavily emphasize unique, thematic focus points. Furthermore, tracking reviews by release date showed a shifting trend: player focus on hardware-driven elements like graphics has declined, while the importance of narrative elements has significantly increased over time. Comparisons across age ratings indicated that narrative intensity and mature themes become more prominent in titles aimed at older audiences. This paper indicates how a game's multifaceted context dynamically shapes player evaluation criteria.

abstract: Deepfake 影像在社群平台傳輸與重新編碼的過程中可能會經歷壓縮、模糊與色彩調整，使原本可被正確辨識的偽造內容逃過偵測，或使真實內容被誤判。本研究在固定分類門檻下量測這類輸入變化對偵測模型的影響，並區分錯誤往誤判或漏判的方向增加。結果顯示，AUC 幾乎不變時，固定分類門檻下的誤判與漏判仍可能大幅上升。

本研究在 HiDF 上以相同資料切分與評估條件比較 ResNet-50、ImageNet ViT-B/16 與 CLIP ViT-B/16，每種模型各以三個隨機種子訓練，並在七類多強度輸入變化下評估，其中五類為影像退化、兩類為診斷性變化（High-pass 與半臉遮擋）。分類門檻由乾淨驗證集以 Youden's J 選定後固定套用至所有輸入條件。評估指標為 AUC、Balanced Accuracy、FPR 與 FNR。

在 198 個非 Original 的模型–輸入條件組合中，31 個（15.7%）的 AUC 平均下降不超過 2 個百分點，但 FPR 或 FNR 平均增加至少 10 個百分點。ImageNet ViT 在 JPEG Q90 這一視覺上幾乎無損的壓縮強度下，平均 AUC 由 97.68% 降至 96.85%，FPR 卻由 5.64% 升至 18.32%。色偏的落差則集中於漏判方向：ResNet-50 的 FNR 隨暖色偏移強度由 4.05% 單調升至 49.84%，而 AUC 全程維持在 96.62% 以上。錯誤上升的方向隨輸入變化與模型而異，誤判與漏判在部署上對應不同的風險。

abstract: Modern military tactical training and scenario simulation require adaptable, risk-free environments to formulate doctrine-aligned strategies, moving beyond the prohibitive costs and safety constraints of traditional live-fire exercises. While reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated effectiveness in micro-level action optimization, it often lacks macro-level strategic reasoning and doctrine interpretability. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes a hierarchical hybrid framework integrating a locally hosted Large Language Model (LLM) with tabular Q-learning, validated in the StarCraft II (PySC2) real-time strategy simulation environment. In our framework, military doctrines (FM 3-0 and ADP 3-90) are incorporated via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to generate structured high-level tactical objectives at macro intervals. These objectives direct an RL action executor, supported by a novel zone-control reward shaping mechanism defined over an 8×8 discretized spatial grid. Experimental results demonstrate that the hybrid agent progressively develops proactive territorial control behaviors and achieves consistent improvements in zone control scores across 2,448 training episodes. This study demonstrates the feasibility of combining doctrine-grounded LLM reasoning with RL execution, offering an interpretable and cost-effective paradigm for AI-driven tactical decision-support systems.

Large language models enable fine-tuning-free spoken language understanding (SLU) through in-context learning, but direct query-based retrieval may select semantically similar yet intent-irrelevant demonstrations. This paper presents Query-Adaptive Intent Detection via Prototype Extraction (APEX), a two-stage retrieval framework that first selects candidate intents using intent-level prototypes and then retrieves contextual exemplars within the selected intent space. Experiments on the SLURP dataset evaluate joint SLU performance using Exact Match Accuracy (EMA) under full-transcript and perplexity-stratified conditions, with additional retrieval analysis on ASR-generated transcripts. Compared with query-based retrieval, APEX improves EMA by 4.34 and 3.97 percentage points with Qwen3-4B and Gemma-3-4B, respectively, on full transcripts. Under high-perplexity inputs, APEX also yields EMA gains of 7.66 and 2.13 percentage points. Retrieval analysis further indicates that prototype-guided candidate selection achieves higher ground-truth intent coverage across multiple input conditions.

Data-driven legal text simplification is bottlenecked by data: the few parallel legal resources that exist align whole documents, sections, or statutes, not individual sentences, and so cannot supervise sentence-level models. We release the first sentence-aligned parallel corpus built on U.S. Supreme Court (SCOTUS) material—2,613 filtered pairs that match plain-language Oyez case summaries to the Court's full opinions from the Pile of Law. Instead of generating simplifications with a language model, which leaves no reusable corpus and can hallucinate in a high-stakes domain, we mine pairs from summaries that human editors already wrote. Our pipeline pairs documents, segments them with legal-domain sentence splitters, and aligns sentences with a bidirectional margin score that fuses the dense and sparse similarities of BGE-M3; crucially, it assumes no sentence ordering, which lets a single summary sentence match content scattered across a long opinion. A cross-encoder then rescores every candidate, and hard filters enforce the length, lexical-overlap, and readability-direction properties a simplification pair must have. On the released corpus the mean Flesch–Kincaid Grade Level drops from 19.0 to 14.3 and the mean cross-encoder relevance score is 0.89. Ablations across three design axes show the corpus is stable because the cross-encoder gate, not the margin, makes the final selection. We frame the result as a plain-language parallel corpus with a consistent readability gap—the summaries remain near college level—and intend it to support future training of legal simplification models.

abstract: 華語是具有華人共同語言地位的通用語，客家語則是漢語族中的一支獨立語言，具備自身獨特的音韻系統與詞彙。本篇論文採用變換式架構模型，針對華語及客家語進行字詞間的翻譯，開發適合客家話特徵的翻譯模型，以提升翻譯的準確性和自然性。我們採用了二種基於變換式架構模型， mT5-small 和 mT5-base 模型，在華語與客家語之間進行翻譯。結透過變換式模型在結合層正規化調整與梯度裁剪技術，能顯著提升翻譯的品質。實驗結果顯示，當 mT5-small 模型結合上述技術後，在 BLEU、ChrF 和 TER 指標上均取得了顯著的提升，顯示出更準確且更流暢的翻譯效果。尤其是梯度裁剪的技術穩定了訓練過程，進而產生了更高質量的翻譯結果。針對更大規模mT5-base 模型的實驗結果顯示，翻譯性能得到了更大的提升。mT5-base 模型擁有更大的容量，使其能在華語與客家語之間提供更細緻的翻譯，並在各項 BLEU 指標上取得了更高的分數。

abstract: Small edits, such as replacing the word dog with or ap- pending the informal phrase no cap to a hypothesis, should not change the label of a natural language inference (NLI) pair, yet they can change the prediction of a fine-tuned classifier. We study two kinds of edit on SNLI and MultiNLI with six fine-tuned encoders: the substitution of 16 nouns by emoji, and the appending of nine informal markers. On average, emoji substitution lowers accuracy by 2.54 to 4.94 points per encoder and appended markers lower it by 4.91 to 12.83 points, but these averages conceal where the accuracy is lost. For emoji, the loss depends on how the replaced nouns are distributed over the two sentences and much less on which noun is replaced. On SNLI it is below one point when the same noun is replaced in both sentences. It is 18 to 24 points for five of the encoders when the premise and the hypothesis contain different replaced nouns. For markers, the loss comes from a few phrases and not from informality as such. Five of nine informal markers cost no more than control phrases, whereas by heaven, which is not informal, changes 39.2% of predictions, more than any marker. A measure that needs no labels ranks the phrases as accuracy does. The two losses also need different fixes: mapping emoji back to nouns at inference removes the emoji loss, and training on other markers recovers 72.1% of the loss on held-out markers. Robustness evaluations should therefore report effects within an edit type and not only its average.

This pilot study examined how information availability relates to role-inference performance by novice humans and large language models (LLMs) in the Werewolf game. Using six logs from five-player games, we compared Target-Role Accuracy at two game stages and classified four logs into Types I–IV accord-ing to their information structures. We evaluated three OpenAI models: gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, and gpt-5.6-luna, with 10 trials per model. In Quiz 4, where ex-plicit evidence was more abundant, the LLM group showed descriptively higher accuracy than the human group in both temporal settings, although neither differ-ence was statistically significant after Holm adjustment. In Quiz 2 for the specific Type IV log, where objective cues were scarce, the human-group mean was 48.3%, compared with 16.7% for the three-model mean. This result does not establish a general human advantage under low-information conditions. Among the seven par-ticipants analyzed for Type IV, mean accuracy increased from 43% on Day 1 to 86% on Day 3 after game experience and repeated presentation. However, the change was not statistically significant (p = 0.25), and only three participants im-proved. Exploratory analysis suggested that LLM errors often reflected interpreta-tions of active behavior as Villager-like, whereas some humans came to consider the strategic intentions behind utterances. Because each type was represented by one log and the human sample was small, these findings are preliminary and lim-ited to the conditions studied. Further research using more participants and inde-pendent game logs is needed to determine whether these patterns generalize.

This paper studies how large language models (LLMs) can enable natural-language workflow construction and editing on the n8n automation platform. We compare six prompt-engineering strategies on GPT-4.1 against three domain fine-tuning input representations across GPT-4.1, Qwen2.5-Coder 32B, and Gemma 2 27B on a shared 300-template benchmark. Structured, plan-based fine-tuning substantially improves schema-grounded generation over the best prompting approach, raising Connection F1 from 0.254 to 0.543 and Parameter Accuracy from 0.273 to 0.450. Building on this, we develop an agentic system that routes natural-language instructions to creation, insertion, or deletion pipelines, pairing the fine-tuned generator with deterministic programmatic control, and compare it with n8n's own Cloud AI Workflow Builder. The proposed system performs competitively on creation and substantially outperforms the official tool on node deletion (100\% vs. 46.7\%, $N=30$); insertion success is low for all three (5--15\%) from omitted parameter values, though ours best preserves untouched nodes (100\% vs. 66.7--86.7\%).

With the rapid advancement of deep learning, artificial intelligence (AI) applications in predicting financial asset price trends have diversified significantly. Accurate forecasts reduce risks and boost returns, particularly in volatile markets like cryptocurrencies, which offer abundant profit opportunities. However, high-frequency trading data, with its second-level fluctuations, poses challenges for models in handling fine-grained details and adaptability. To tackle these issues, this study introduces a novel hybrid architecture integrating a fine-tuned large language model (LLM) with a daily-retrained deep learning model. The LLM excels at extracting short-term market patterns from vast second-level historical data, addressing traditional models' limitations in retaining past patterns amid massive datasets. Conversely, the deep learning component adapts to long-term trends. To enhance prediction accuracy, we incorporate first-, third-, and fourth-order statistical moments to capture distributional characteristics of price fluctuations. The workflow involves feeding historical data into the LLM for signal generation, then combining these with statistical moments and cross-asset data to support the deep learning model's price movement predictions. Experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms standard deep learning models, improving accuracy by 5\% to 25\%, confirming the architecture's efficacy.

Assessing argument quality in earnings call statements is essential for interpreting the specificity, persuasiveness, strength, and objectivity of managerial communication. Yet strong performance on individual dimensions does not guarantee that an automated judge preserves the relationships among them. To address this gap, this study investigates the structural fidelity of multidimensional LLM judges and examines whether higher task performance corresponds to better preservation of human-referenced score relationships. We compare three judging systems, namely few-shot prompting, fine-tuning, and a post-hoc correction pipeline, using overall and OBJECTIVE-specific correlation distances, a conditional independence null model, and robustness analyses. The primary comparison is an exploratory analysis of these preexisting systems on a shared 359-statement development split, on which the pipeline's post-hoc rules were tuned. Human annotations exhibit a two-block pattern in which OBJECTIVE is comparatively weakly associated with SPECIFIC, PERSUASIVE, and STRONG. Relative to the observed human labels, most OBJECTIVE-related correlations are higher in the automated outputs, although this direction is sensitive to uncertainty and attenuation in the human reference, and on this split the fine-tuned system shows the largest OBJECTIVE-specific deviation, an ordering not reproduced on a 131-statement held-out subset. The observed comparisons suggest that higher Macro-F1 need not coincide with smaller reference-relative structural discrepancies. Controlled manipulations further show that joint elicitation raises overall but not detectably OBJECTIVE-specific coupling, while false-score disclosure produces only modest, dimension-dependent shifts. These findings extend multidimensional evaluation beyond criterion-level accuracy and provide a reference-based diagnostic for detecting cross-dimensional distortion. In practice, automated judges should be assessed using both predictive performance and structural behavior before they are used in evaluation or decision-support settings.

While digital natives frequently read massive amounts of text on social media without fatigue, they often experience severe psychological aversion and cognitive load when confronted with dense, full-length book pages. Existing e-book designs primarily tweak low-level typography (e.g., font size, line spacing) but fail to address the initial visual dread of ``walls of text.'' In this study, we propose a novel reading support approach that transforms full-text literary novels into familiar social media interfaces---specifically modeling LINE (messaging app), X (microblog feed), and 5ch (bulletin board system, BBS)---alongside an e-book baseline. We modernized ten public-domain Japanese novels and evaluated reading behavior across 20 participants in an experiment with balanced novel--interface assignments, measuring page dwell time, reading speed, text comprehension, and subjective cognitive load (NASA-TLX-inspired 14-item questionnaire). The results reveal that while mean comprehension scores were descriptively similar across interfaces, the LINE-style messaging app interface received favorable subjective evaluations among reluctant readers. These findings suggest that familiar chat and feed layouts may make literary reading more approachable for digital-generation readers.

Persuasion is becoming a machine capability. Randomized studies now find that language-model-written messages change political and factual attitudes at least as much as human-written ones, and this capability couples naturally to the behavioral and affective forecasting that a decade of engagement optimization already produces. We call this coupling AI neuro-persuasion and argue that it is best understood not as a new kind of manipulation but as a multiplier on manipulation that already exists. The contribution is a way to reason about where that multiplier does the most damage. We state a general principle, the steepest derivative: the marginal harm from each increment of persuasion capability is largest where three conditions coincide, a high baseline of organized manipulation, high population vulnerability, and the absence of \emph{model-level} auditing, the ability to test the systems themselves rather than only the content they emit. We treat the ``derivative, not level'' framing as an organizing device rather than a fitted model, and we show the three conditions are general by instantiating them across contexts, synthetic-media financial fraud, electoral information operations, personalized political targeting, and a focused multi-region case study where all three conditions are acute at once. We then add a measurable, cross-cutting vector: models aligned to a principal carry directional loyalties, and as users come to treat a chatbot as a neutral expert those loyalties become standing influence infrastructure. A secondary analysis of published refusal-rate data quantifies one instance, a state-aligned model refuses origin-sensitive prompts at a risk difference of $26$ to $31$ percentage points over comparable models (Cohen's $h = 0.74$ to $1.06$), with no matching elevation on the other side. We engage the counter-capacity that already exists, fact-checking, platform moderation, and media literacy, and argue why it does not reach the model level. As an existence proof that a defense is buildable and deployable by any body that needs one, we describe a small-model instrument coupling a behavioral forecaster with an abstaining cognitive-security check, validated on synthetic controls only and released as open, inspectable code. We make no claim to have measured persuasion in any named campaign.

Blockchain-based Federated Learning (BCFL) remains vulnerable to gradient mimicry attacks, in which malicious clients imitate the behavior of honest ones. We study how such attackers degrade a BCFL system protected by FoolsGold and Multi-Krum, and propose ShardedGold, a defense that combines gradient sharding with an enhanced FoolsGold algorithm adding an Order-based penalty score and a Consistency score, and that stores shards in the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) with on-chain Content Identifiers (CIDs) to overcome ledger storage limits. We evaluate the full attacker range from 0 to 50% of clients on MNIST and CIFAR-10 and compare against FoolsGold+Multi-Krum run through an identical pipeline. Under the evaluated protocol, ShardedGold keeps malicious clients' aggregation weight below that of honest clients and preserves accuracy up to moderate attacker fractions, degrading gradually beyond them, with accuracy on par with FoolsGold+Multi-Krum. Repeated runs further reveal a bimodal convergence instability that concentrates at intermediate attacker fractions rather than at the maximum, a pattern visible only across multiple runs.

Large language models are increasingly deployed as smart-contract vulnerability auditors. We ask whether such auditors can be evaded by rewrites that provably do not change what a contract does. Using 130 labelled contracts from SmartBugs-Curated and SolidiFI across five vulnerability classes, seven LLM auditors spanning three model families, and six semantic-preserving source transformations (identifier renaming, dead-code insertion, comment stripping, control-flow rewriting, inlining, and reformatting) verified behaviour-preserving at a 99.7% rate by bytecode identity or differential execution, we report two findings. First, obfuscation does not degrade auditors on average - mean evasion is within +/-3 percentage points - but it opens specific, reproducible blind spots: on arithmetic bugs, stripping comments alone collapses the recall of a well-calibrated cheap auditor (Qwen2.5-7B) from 0.88 to 0.48 while its false-positive rate stays at 0.00, with non-overlapping bootstrap confidence intervals at n=33. Comments, not code, were carrying the detection. Second, and more troubling for the field, most auditors we test are degenerate: the largest model (Llama-3.3-70B) attains perfect reentrancy recall while flagging 93% of non-vulnerable contracts, i.e. precision 0.33. Because recall rewards indiscriminate flagging, a recall-only evaluation both overstates auditor quality and makes robustness-to-obfuscation unmeasurable - an apparent "capability confers robustness" correlation (rho = -0.82) is confounded by exactly this effect and is not statistically significant (p = 0.13, five models). Finally, the obvious mitigation fails: escalating to the largest model restores recall (0.46 to 0.96) but inflates false positives (0.00 to 0.26, and to 0.94 on reentrancy). We argue that LLM smart-contract auditors must be evaluated with precision alongside recall, and that cosmetic-robustness testing belongs in that evaluation.

Can observed signal quality and sensor-removal sensitivity reveal activity-classification errors under a sensor-fault family excluded from training and calibration? We test this hypothesis on UCI HAR while preserving its nine official test participants. For each of five simulated fault families, a compact CNN, three logistic correctness predictors, temperature scaling, entropy, and MC dropout exclude that family from every fitting stage. Three classifier seeds and paired corruptions cover 30 held-out family severity sensor-group conditions. Fault augmentation improves mean held-out accuracy from 67.7% to 71.0%, versus 89.9% on clean test windows. However, adding quality and removal features to the confidence-only correctness predictor worsens the prespecified area under the risk-coverage curve (AURC, lower is better) from 0.1473±0.0084 to 0.1681 ± 0.0110. The paired participant-bootstrap difference is +0.0208 (95% interval [+0.0116, +0.0297]). The expanded score helps for held out missing segments and noise, but fails for bias, gain, and freeze; it also raises error AUPRC from 0.560 to 0.574 and slightly lowers risk at 80% coverage, showing that ranking summaries need not agree. A 14k-parameter GRU and a reduced reconstruction-pretraining control, each run on a single seed, are consistent with the same negative AURC pattern. These results reject the broad hypothesis that inexpensive quality and removal signals reliably improve selective HAR under an unseen fault family, and identify family-dependent score transfer as the central obstacle.

abstract: Institutional collections evolve continuously through amendments, administrative memos, and budget revisions. In such versioned collections, standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can fail because retrieval optimizes semantic relevance rather than temporal or administrative authority. We study this problem on 27 government AI-infrastructure documents containing 92 embedded images and propose a two-phase framework combining offline scope-aware agentic evidence synthesis with online Hierarchical Dual-Store RAG. The offline pipeline performs multimodal inspection, temporal and scope-aware arbitration, and fresh-session auditing to construct a reviewed Single Source of Truth (SSoT), while the online architecture retrieves from both SSoT and archival stores under an explicit priority prompt. Multimodal inspection uncovered a 20-fold discrepancy between narrative text (NTD 20 million) and an operative table (NTD 1 million), while fresh-session review identified an erroneous budget growth rate of 37.7% and recalculated it as 41.8%. On a 100-question adversarial benchmark spanning three conflict modes and one factoid control category, the proposed configuration achieved an 85.0% automated answer-match rate, a +35.0 percentage-point gain over single-store hybrid RAG. Its retrieved-context budget is estimated to be approximately 83% smaller than full-context injection; this is not a measured end-to-end cost reduction. Exploratory inspection of non-matches and trap flags identified matching limitations, unused retrieved evidence, rubric misalignment, and residual numerical contamination. No independently validated semantic accuracy is claimed; the original automated scores remain the primary results. These findings support evaluating authority-aware evidence arbitration alongside online retrieval in evolving document repositories.

Reliable cross-patient evaluation in electroencephalography (EEG) seizure forecasting requires more than disjoint case identifiers. We audit two evaluation protocols on the CHB-MIT scalp EEG database and show how a benchmark can appear patient-disjoint while violating biological subject separation and concentrating all positive test support in one case. On an original three-way split, the strongest transfer-pretrained configuration achieved validation AUROC 0.810 and AUPRC 0.170 but test AUROC 0.535 and AUPRC 0.0158. A later unified split, used for transformer, CNN, and BENDR comparisons, produced pooled window-level AUROC 0.9890 and AUPRC 0.4617 with corrected normalization. However, CHB-MIT documents chb21 as a later recording from the same biological subject as chb01; the unified protocol places chb01 in training and chb21 in testing. In addition, all 1,174 retained positive test windows came from chb24, while chb20–chb23 contributed only retained inter-ictal windows under the preprocessing pipeline despite public case summaries documenting seizures in each case. Because 98.82% of the unified test negatives come from chb20–chb23, the pooled AUROC is numerically dominated by cross-case positive–negative comparisons and cannot establish within-subject or multi-subject positive-class generalization. We further examine normalization, score compression, temporal aggregation, time-to-onset behavior, and window-level uncertainty, and derive a practical audit checklist for rare-event biomedical time-series evaluation.

abstract: False-positive corrections remain a critical barrier to deploying Chinese Spelling Check (CSC) systems in real-world educational and language-processing set-tings. Incorrectly modifying valid expressions can adversely affect learning, data quality, and downstream knowledge construction. This study examines the benchmark–real-world gap arising from natural language variation, identifying character variants, fixed expressions, and Traditional–Simplified Chinese coexist-ence as major sources of false positives and data inconsistency. To address these challenges, we propose a consensus-based framework integrating heterogeneous models and applying corrections only when both agree, thereby improving relia-bility. Experimental results achieve a false-positive rate of 0.293, 98.2% preci-sion, 66.2% recall, and 79.1% F1-score, demonstrating the trade-off between cor-rection reliability and error coverage. Contributions: (1) deployment-oriented false-positive control; (2) analysis of contextual linguistic variations; and (3) a robust, high-precision consensus-based CSC framework.

Existing legal benchmarks for LLMs focus mostly on answering legal questions, including multiple-choice questions, classification, judgment prediction, and document drafting. Although courtroom simulations of legal practice have been studied, they mostly use the debate as a means or study the simulation itself, and rarely score the advocates in it as a large-scale benchmark. We propose LAWRENCE (LAWyering under adversarial debate, evaluated on Reasoning, Engagement, Normative Correctness, and Ethics), a framework and evaluation method in which a multi-agent system simulates legal practice through adversarial debate grounded in real Taiwanese criminal judgments. With prosecutor, defense counsel, and judge agents, we ran roughly 1,000 simulated courtroom debates, comprising about 20 million Chinese characters, under both self-play and fixed opponents drawn from different models. The LLM judge we selected reaches a Pearson correlation of $+0.829$ with a human evaluator on the weighted total, averaged over the two sides (single evaluator, single case). The leaderboards indicate the broad standing of models, but their noise prevents a precise measure of model ability; we therefore analyze this noise, find that run-to-run noise arises mainly from debate generation, and identify directions in which the debate framework and the judge agent can be improved. This study thus represents an initial attempt at using adversarial debate over legal practice as a standard of evaluation.

abstract: Tool-using large language model agents may reveal failure evidence before task completion, yet pooled prediction can be confounded by domain identity and variable trajectory length. We present FIVE (Failure Inference from Visible Evidence), a prefix-only framework that converts the first $K$ scored events into deterministic process evidence and estimates eventual failure with a conventional classifier. FIVE denotes the complete protocol, while FIVE-30 is its 30-feature representation: Core-18 summarizes step quality, drift, and information gain, and Relation-12 captures grounding, evidence use, repetition, action diversity, effort, and error persistence. Outcome labels are observed only after run completion, but each prediction at $K$ uses no future events and can be updated incrementally during execution. We evaluate FIVE on 400 $\tau^2$-Bench runs comprising 8,372 post-request scored events using task-grouped cross-validation, with test tasks excluded from model fitting. FIVE-30 provided moderate discrimination with full coverage at $K=3$, but a comparable domain-prior baseline showed that domain composition materially influenced pooled performance. At $K=20$, relational features improved all four classifiers, although coverage fell to 34.25%; fully nested selection yielded a more conservative AUROC of 0.686. FIVE therefore offers a transparent, cohort-aware framework for online failure-risk estimation that can support early stopping or escalation; the benefit of acting on these predictions requires prospective evaluation.

Sustainability reports are increasingly used to assess corporate environmental, social, and governance performance, yet evidence required by sector-specific sustainability disclosure standards is often fragmented across narrative text, tables, footnotes, and image-based PDF content. Existing page-level classification approaches typically rely on flat relevance or multi-class decisions, making it difficult to explicitly distinguish between irrelevant evidence and relevant but incomplete disclosure evidence. This study therefore proposes a calibrated hierarchical structured decision framework that decomposes SASB compliance evidence classification into two sequential dimensions: topical relevance and evidence completeness. Using 378 annotated records from Chinese sustainability reports, the framework integrates native PDF text and OCR-enhanced evidence and compares a character n-gram TF–IDF baseline, flat structured classification, and hierarchical structured decisions; decision thresholds are selected exclusively from training data using five-fold cross-validation. On the 189-record exploratory test split, the proposed framework achieves 73.02% accuracy and 60.39% macro-F1, compared with 46.03% accuracy and 35.12% macro-F1 for the strongest TF–IDF baseline, while the yes but not complete class remains challenging with an F1-score of 27.59%. Ablation results suggest that threshold calibration, which the flat baseline did not receive, accounts for most of the gain over flat classification; these findings remain exploratory. The main contribution of this study is to advance SASB compliance evidence classification from flat page-level labeling toward a calibrated hierarchical structured decision paradigm that explicitly models relevance and completeness as distinct decision dimensions, thereby improving transparency and auditability. The practical implication is that ESG analysts and assurance teams can apply the framework as a human-in-the-loop triage mechanism to prioritize clear cases and route incomplete or uncertain disclosures, together with preserved source-page evidence, for targeted verification.

We study weighted envy-freeness up to one item (WEF1) for additive mixed goods-and-chores allocation with unequal entitlements. A good is an item that all agents evaluate positively, while a chore is a task with negative value for all agents, such as cleaning a restroom. The mixed setting is difficult because positive and negative items interact after normalization by agent weights: a fairness witness that works for the goods subproblem or the chores subproblem need not remain valid after the two parts are merged. We start from the known two-phase construction of Garg and Sharma (2024), which guarantees weighted envy-freeness up to one transfer (WEF1T) after merging goods-side and chores-side WEF1 allocations. This known guarantee is not a WEF1 guarantee, and we do not claim it as our own algorithmic contribution. Our contribution is an empirical study of when the merged allocation is already WEF1 and when local repair helps. Our experiments specify ordinary and structured goods-ratio generators, run 3,600 trials in each regime, report confidence intervals, repair depth, repair baselines, runtime, and welfare effects, and include a small instance demonstrating a local-search failure. Ordinary random trials produce no WEF1 failures. Structured trials expose 217 initial failures, and best-improvement repair fixes those failures in one step in this set of instances. The results show that the goods ratio \(r=|G|/|M|\), where \(G\) denotes the set of goods and \(M\) the set of all items, is not a reliable predictor of WEF1 success. Difficulty arises from the interaction of the goods ratio, entitlement configuration, concentrated desirable goods, and high-cost chores.

abstract: 近年來，數據呈現出越來越分散的趨勢，導致眾多分佈式數據庫的出現。Google提出了一種名為聯邦學習的新型機器學習方法，該方法在保護本地數據隱私的基礎上，實現多方協同訓練機器學習模型。然而，在傳統聯邦學習方法中，伺服器通常不直接參與訓練任務。本篇研究聚焦於伺服器是否可以參與訓練過程的可行性，特別是針對伺服器提供部分數據集或持有專屬數據集的場景進行探討，以最大程度地發揮伺服器在計算能力上的優勢。本研究引入了兩種學習方法來獲取更優的模型性能。第一種方法為預訓練策略，該方法中伺服器首先在本地完成多輪訓練以生成初始模型，然後將其分發給所有客戶端節點進行深度學習。第二種方法則是訓練中的學習策略，即伺服器在每輪聯邦學習聚合後，利用自有數據集執行單輪本地訓練，以進一步優化模型性能。為驗證提出方法的有效性，本研究使用了CIFAR-10與CIFAR-100這兩個數據集進行實驗分析，探討了伺服器參與聯邦學習過程的可行性，同時對這兩種學習方法在提升模型性能方面的表現進行了比較和評估。

abstract: 本研究提出結合表示法與錯誤回饋的大型語言模型測資生成流程。四項作業、每種方法三次、每組20筆測資的結果顯示，EBNF平均初始與兩階段整體錯誤現象數最高，為11.00與19.25；EFSM平均對抗性與新增錯誤現象數最高，為13.25與10.25，觀察及完整錯誤揭露率最高，為28.76%與25.74%。研究結果顯示，相較於直接生成，表示法引導的提示設計能提升錯誤揭露能力，其中 EFSM 在對抗性測資階段具有較佳的補充效果。

abstract: 情緒原因組合提取任務（Emotion-Cause Pair Extraction, ECPE）需要找出文檔中所有的情緒子句與原因子句，也要判定二者的對應關係。因此，標註成本與品質需求都很高。大多數相關研究著重在監督式學習下提升提取結果的準確度，本研究則針對在少量已標註文檔的環境下，利用佔多數的未標註文檔提升ECPE任務的表現。我們結合提示微調（Prompt-Tuning）與自訓練（Self-Training）的技術，透過提示微調可同時進行多個預測任務的特性，讓我們能統合不同任務的偽標籤在自訓練過程中，並在此架構上提出子任務模型參數融合的做法。

abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly employed as simulated players for evaluating game designs. Existing agent benchmarks, however, primarily measure task success rather than behavioral consistency with an assigned player persona. This paper introduces IAP-Bench, a benchmark that evaluates persona-conditioned agents on in-app purchase (IAP) designs prevalent in free-to-play games. Four personas, defined by spending tier, are specified with explicit rules that are verified automatically. Four LLMs are evaluated on 14 conditions and on four variants of a single offer, yielding 5,760 decisions, and one small model is included for contrast. The four models exhibit strong agreement on the perceived fairness of offers, with a mean pairwise Spearman’s ρ of 0.92, but only moderate agreement on purchase rankings, with ρ = 0.62. Rule violations occur in 0.9% of scenario decisions and in 3.2% of design-study decisions. The absolute rule of never paying is almost always observed, whereas the conditional rule that prohibits one-time rescue items is violated in 0.8–8.9% of the minnow’s decisions. The contrast model, Gemma 3 4B, violates its rules in 21% of decisions, compared with 0.2–3.3% for the four main models. The results indicate that capable LLM agents reflect distinct player types and can support the analysis of monetization designs.

abstract: 本研究針對LLM Agent應用於個人化食譜推薦系統中，大多缺乏能同時兼顧長期穩定偏好、短期情境需求與偏好漂移衝突之結構化記憶管理機制，致使長期互動下的使用者理解難以維持一致與準確的問題，設計一套具動態偏好適應能力的管理機制。系統採Main Agent與Preference Analyzer的雙Agent架構，並將使用者資訊分為硬性限制、長期軟性偏好與短期狀態三層記憶，同時結合偏好更新門檻、Confidence評估及指數衰減機制，依據使用者互動訊號與時間變化調整偏好記憶。研究透過明確陳述、隱含推論、矛盾訊號及情境需求四種情境進行功能測試。結果顯示，系統能依據不同類型的使用者訊號更新或保留偏好，逐步處理偏好變化，並避免將一次性的情境需求納入長期記憶。未來可進一步整合更多行為資料，並延伸至跨會話飲食規劃與主動推薦。

abstract: 大型語言模型代理 (Large Language Model Agent, LLM Agent) 已逐步具備工具使用與任務執行能力，如何將其整合至企業資訊系統成為值得探討的議題。本研究以 SAP S/4HANA 銷售與配銷 (Sales and Distribution, SD) 模組為驗證情境，建構一套基於 WebMCP 的 ERP Agent 原型架構，讓使用者無須直接操作 ERP 原生介面，即可透過自然語言提出需求，由 Agent 利用網頁提供的功能與 SAP OData 執行跨文件查詢並呈現結果。 本研究進一步比較技術導向、型別導向與語意導向三種工具描述，探討企業語意對 Agent 任務執行的影響。結果顯示，在較寬鬆的操作額度下，三組皆具有較高的任務完成率；當限制至最少必要操作數時，各組在工具選擇與執行路徑上呈現差異，但未達統計顯著。研究顯示，WebMCP 具備整合 ERP Agent 的可行性，而企業語意雖未顯著提升任務效率，但可能影響 Agent 的工具選擇與執行路徑。

A weak audio classifier can correct some errors of a stronger text classifier, but selecting audio indiscriminately also causes damage. We study this problem on the Multimodal EmotionLines Dataset (MELD). We compare trained fusion models with a large language model (LLM) judge that reads dialogue text and the two classifiers’ candidate labels. The judge’s relative support selects between those labels, increasing support-weighted F1 (WF1) from 63.76 to 66.46. Combining its full class scores with text instead reaches 68.41 WF1 and increases macro-averaged F1 (MF1) from 46.49 to 55.33. Output composition improves four backbone–text references, whereas shuffled scores and the tested training-time injections do not reproduce those gains. Prediction-change counts distinguish useful corrections from damage. The results support testing decision-level integration in this setting; they remain exploratory because earlier model development consulted the test set.

This study integrates a Large Language Model (LLM) with a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture to build a cloud-based dashboard that combines Internet of Things (IoT) data—including underwater cameras, temperature probes, and driftwood-tracking records—with AI prediction models, providing real-time queries and intelligent question-answering services. This strengthens science communication and cross-domain decision support, complementing ongoing efforts in ecological restoration, material innovation, and education outreach to jointly advance data-driven governance. The study site is the Penghu area, where coral in nearby waters has suffered massive mortality in recent years due to climate change. Our team's coral restoration work in the waters of Penghu can help the region develop tourism, offering new approaches for promoting climate resilience and sustainable ocean governance.

Getting humanoid robots to turn natural-language emotional expressions into physical motion is still hard, especially on low-cost hardware that cannot run large end-to-end models. We present HMPA (Hybrid Motor-Proprioception Architecture), a training-free neuro-symbolic pipeline with four layers. A locally hosted large language model (LLM) maps an utterance to a small set of posture parameters (Semantic Motor Imagery); these are interpolated into a trajectory and solved into servo commands by an analytic inverse-kinematics layer (Morphological Negotiation); every frame then passes a rule-based Geometric Safety Valve that enforces joint limits, prevents arm-body self-collision, and checks static stability before the execution driver sends it to the robot. A "Physics of Emotion" prompt tells the LLM how emotions map onto body geometry (height, lean, arm aperture, and timing) instead of asking it for raw joint values. We deployed HMPA on a 16-servo PlayRobot EDE0256 humanoid and generated motions for 40 emotional prompts. A human evaluator rated each recorded video on a three-point scale. The mean semantic-match score was 1.32 and the mean emotional-intensity score was 1.32; only 4 motions clearly matched the intended emotion and 22.5% matched it at least partially. The pipeline produced an executable motion for every prompt on inexpensive hardware, and prototypical emotions such as happiness, sadness, and calm were conveyed clearly, but most emotions were not recognizable from posture alone. These results locate the main bottleneck in expressiveness rather than in feasibility.

Large language models (LLMs) make companion robots conversational, but an LLM that can command motion turns a wrong answer into a physical risk. Our quadruped system, built on ROS 2 and a Unitree Go2 Pro with an 8 GB Jetson Orin Nano Super, separates the two: the LLM may propose at most one skill from a fixed allowlist, and a deterministic Interaction Executive alone decides whether any motion is dispatched. Each gate decision is recorded with its reason, and an operator Studio makes these records inspectable. A 26-person exploratory survey, mostly of demonstration viewers, found perceived intelligence higher than perceived safety (3.76 vs 3.40, paired Wilcoxon p = .015), which motivates, but does not test, safety control that is visible as well as enforced.

Academic publication registration is critical to university administration, yet manual entry is time-consuming and error-prone across 30+ structured fields. This paper presents a non-intrusive automated registration system, implemented as a Chrome Extension, that integrates parallel queries to CrossRef (with DataCite as fallback), OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, and Unpaywall, together with DBLP-based indexing checks, and applies LLM-based field mapping, using National Chengchi University's publication catalog system as a case study. An ORCID two-stage matching mechanism periodically detects unregistered works and labels them for user confirmation rather than automatic filtering. A three-layer PDF extraction strategy (binary DOI scan, metadata parsing, PDF.js text extraction up to two pages with garbled-text detection) further handles diverse PDF types. Model selection together with two prompt optimization strategies reduced AI field-mapping response time from approximately 26 to 8 seconds, yielding a total end-to-end wait time of about 12 to 16 seconds.

abstract: General-purpose LLM sentence embeddings lack domain-specific semantic sensitivity. We propose a hybrid strategy that freezes the pretrained encoder and trains a lightweight Dense adaptation network on Ward-clustering pseudo-labels, mapping embeddings into a 64-dimensional domain-specific space. On 400 UK visa regulations, stratified 5-fold cross-validation shows that the test-fold Silhouette rises from 0.15 to 0.51 (MPNet) and from 0.12 to 0.48 (OpenAI), outperforming PCA, UMAP and LDA. On 20 Newsgroups, evaluated against original categories never used in training, the Silhouette of true categories rises from 0.07 to 0.27, while an oracle trained on true categories reaches 0.41, showing that the adaptation network is effective and performance is bounded by pseudo-label quality. Keywords: Domain-specific Embedding, Supervised Embedding Adaptation, Knowledge Graph, Semantic Clustering, Pseudo-labels.

abstract: 本研究以台灣加權指數（TAIEX）已實現波動度為預測標的，結合技術面與中文新聞情緒特徵，以技術面（含當日 RV）為基準，並以 walk-forward 逐折配對檢定取代單次切分評估。實證發現新聞情緒對短窗口（次日、次週）波動度具顯著貢獻，長窗口（h=10、22）則各檢定結論不一致；此效應已由Audrino et al. [1]於美股證實，本研究貢獻在於：於散戶成交比重遠高於美股之台灣市場重新驗證，並發現單一衰減設定皆無法穩定重現此效應，以多維半衰期特徵輸入表現較佳。

abstract: 本研究探討翻譯語言應用於垃圾簡訊辨識之可行性。以 UCI SMS Spam Collection經前處理後之 5,572 筆英文簡訊為資料來源，透過 Qwen3-8B翻譯為繁體中文，並保留正常訊息（ham）與垃圾訊息（spam）標籤。研究採用 BERT-tiny、Chinese RoBERTa與 XLM-RoBERTa，分別以中英文語料進行微調（fine-tuning），並以四種條件比較跨語言的辨識表現，以Accuracy、Precision、Recall 與 F1-Score 進行評估。實驗結果顯示，各模型於原驗證集皆具有良好表現，其中 XLM-R的垃圾訊息 F1-Score 達 0.95 以上；然而，在不同訊息情境的測試集中，模型效能明顯下降。結果顯示，翻譯既有英文標註語料可作為建立繁體中文訓練資料的可行方法，但辨識效能仍受到模型預訓練背景、翻譯品質及資料分布等因素影響。

abstract: 在法律文本分類領域，部分分類模型存在黑箱問題，使用者難以理解其分類依據。過去多以單字或單句解釋分類模型，雖能標註關鍵內容，但解釋單位較為零碎，可能使法律論述脈絡難以理解。本文提出基於修辭角色與語意一致性片段擾動之法律文本分類解釋，將相同語意詞彙的句子合併，提升解釋效果與可讀性。為提升分類結果的可解釋性，本文提出 SPS-LIME，以修辭角色將相鄰同角色句子合併為語意片段，透過片段擾動與局部代理模型估計各片段對預測的貢獻，再定位片段內的關鍵句子，呈現由論證區塊至句子的雙層解釋，協助使用者回查影響預測的原文內容。SCOTUS 原設定下，片段擾動的 Consistency 為 0.7591、COMP 為 0.0859，均高於詞級與句級擾動；ECtHR 輔助分析亦呈相近趨勢。然而，擾動粒度與文字覆蓋率尚未受控，跨法域角色標註及不同分類器上的適用性仍待驗證。本文提供結構化的局部解釋流程；其歸因反映模型行為，不等同法律推理正確性，亦未經使用者研究驗證理解效果。

abstract: 臺灣地熱探勘的早期潛能區篩選仍高度依賴地質師人工判釋。本文整理同一地熱資料整合計畫下的三項 GeoAI 應用：以 U-Net 從數值地形模型反演的 12 項地形因子判釋地表線型（滲透性通道）；以 LightGBM 整合 Landsat-8 波段、地形因子與大地電磁法電阻率判釋地表溫度異常區（熱源顯示）；以地端部署之大型語言模型結合地質詞彙庫與檢索增強生成建置地質智慧問答模組。前兩項為獨立的概念驗證研究，第三項已納入上線運作之空間資訊整合系統。以大屯火山群標記訓練的線型模型套用至臺東紅葉與花蓮瑞穗兩處變質岩案場，初步產生與地形紋理相符的線型分布，可歸因於模型僅以地形因子為輸入，惟其構造意義仍待地質驗證；線型模型訓練區測試集 F1 為 0.57；溫度異常模型驗證集 AUC 為 0.91、F1 為 0.86，改以 6 公尺光達地形重算地形因子後召回率提高至 0.92，特徵重要度顯示近紅外與紅光波段及淺層電阻率主導判斷。本文並說明三項應用的分工與定位、現階段的驗證缺口與後續發展。

abstract: Decentralized multi-agent systems increasingly rely on shared information, yet repeated interactions allow locally plausible actions to accumulate into distributed harm. We propose an automated trust-management framework that converts noisy monitor scores into directed local trust, aggregates them into a global reputation via an EigenTrust-style process, and removes persistently low-reputation agents. Building on this framework, we study an adaptive Red syndicate using shared Q-learning to farm trust, attack benign agents, smear reputations, or boost malicious teammates. We evaluate pretrust, removal threshold population, defense calibration, and Red observation regimes on attacks, Red survival and eradication, and Blue false isolation. In evaluated regimes, including pretrust anchors in threshold computation can prevent removal; excluding them restores operation but reveals an attack-false isolation trade-off. Full manipulation generally increases attacks and Red survival, while post-attack credence has limited aggregate impact despite affecting greedy action preferences. Results characterize adversarial trust dynamics under uncertain monitoring.
