abstract: 本研究從 NLP representation learning 與 AI emotion modeling 的角度，探討不同認知與語意抽象層次的情緒在 sentence embedding space 中的幾何表徵特性。研究建立包含 12 類情緒、共 1,200 筆英文語句之語料集，並提出 Basic、Reflective 與 Inner 三層操作性情緒架構。實驗採用 all-mpnet-base-v2 與 e5-base-v2 產生句向量，結合 UMAP、silhouette score、centroid cosine distance 與 one-sided permutation test，分析不同情緒層次的群聚、重疊與分離情形。結果顯示，MPNet 與 E5 均呈現一致的 Basic > Reflective > Inner 語意分離度趨勢；其中 Basic 具有較明確的語意邊界，而 Reflective 與 Inner 則呈現較高的重疊與連續性。整體而言，本研究顯示 embedding-space geometry 可提供傳統 emotion classification 指標以外的 representation-level 分析觀點，並可作為後續 hierarchy-aware 或 continuous AI emotion modeling 之研究基礎。

Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables language models to adapt retrieval based on previously retrieved evidence, but it remains unclear whether such adaptive orchestration consistently outperforms well-designed static pipelines. We conduct a controlled comparison of agentic and static RAG for Taiwanese historical question answering, sharing the same generator and hybrid retrieval backend. Despite similar aggregate performance, the two pipelines differ on 70.83% of questions, with their advantages largely canceling out when averaged. An oracle that selects the better response per question improves the composite score by 0.2417 over the better individual pipeline, revealing substantial headroom for question-level selection. We therefore introduce a post-hoc selector that compares the two responses and their cited evidence, significantly outperforming either individual pipeline and recovering 60.34% of the oracle headroom. These results show that aggregate comparisons can obscure meaningful question-level differences between retrieval strategies, suggesting that exploiting their complementarity may be more fruitful than seeking a universally superior pipeline.

Malware sandbox reports are often too verbose for timely analysis, as their commands, filenames, and URLs require manual interpretation and validation by analysts. Because these artifacts originate from an untrusted sample, they cannot be treated as trustworthy evidence without additional validation. This paper presents a Safe Agentic Framework for Evidence-Grounded Triage (SAFE-T), a client–host agent architecture for malware triage. In SAFE-T, a client-side LLM agent selectively retrieves relevant sandbox evidence through bounded read-only tools to produce a concise behavioral summary containing claims, evidence anchors, and ATT\&CK tactic labels. The host then validates the evidence, filters unsupported claims, and verifies the ATT\&CK tactic assignments. Finally, the host summarizes unsupported claims in an explicit abstention message, helping analysts make informed decisions based on the malware sandbox report. We evaluated SAFE-T with six backend models---Gemma4-31B, Gemma4-26B-A4B, GPT-OSS-20B, Qwen3-32B, Qwen3-4B-Instruct, and Mistral-7B---on Paper300, a 300-report cohort based on Avast-CTU reports that combines 209 tactic-annotated reports with 91 adversarial variants. SAFE-T achieved tactic micro-F1 ranged from 0.857--0.893, compared with 0.419--0.658 for passive one-shot and 0.178--0.680 for passive multi-shot prompting on identical evidence catalogs. All published SAFE-T claims had traceable evidence anchors, yielding a grounding rate of 1.000 under the catalog-based metric.

abstract: With ROS 2 increasingly deployed in real-world robotic systems, securing inter-node communication is critical for safe operation. However, existing security research largely focuses on network-layer authentication, leaving open what an authenticated insider or a physically-present attacker can accomplish. This study presents an empirically validated, three-layer security assessment of ROS 2 integrating network authentication evaluation, behavioral anomaly detection, and firmware-layer analysis. At the network layer, SROS2 is evaluated against six attack classes, showing that cryptographic authentication restricts unauthorized access while highlighting the need for behavior-level evaluation among credentialed nodes. Building on this insight, two lightweight statistical anomaly monitors -- a rate-based watchdog and a kinematic-plausibility filter -- are designed for authenticated attackers that SROS2 cannot identify: the watchdog blocks all evaluated flood messages, while the plausibility filter rejects kinematically implausible commands. Together, the two monitors introduce a mean end-to-end latency of 4.87 ms, with a false-positive rate of 0.036% (over 99.96% of legitimate commands preserved). As network and behavioral defenses depend on traffic passing through the ROS graph, the OpenCR controller is reverse-engineered; proof-of-concept exploits assessed through CPU emulation and, where applicable, physical-hardware actuation tests show that the evaluated firmware-layer attacks can bypass network- and ROS-layer defenses. These results demonstrate that network authentication and behavioral anomaly detection provide complementary protection against unauthenticated network attacks and authenticated-insider attacks, while the firmware findings expose an additional protection gap that requires firmware- or hardware-level safeguards.

abstract: Web application firewalls (WAFs) remain vulnerable to encoded and context-dependent cross-site scripting (XSS) payloads. We present V-ADAPT, a verified adversarial discovery and protection framework linking attack discovery to defensive repair. AEG-Flow combines large language model (LLM) seed generation, Double Deep Q-Network (DDQN) mutation, and Playwright browser validation. DIS-Flow generates rules from discovered bypasses and inspects original and recursively decoded inputs in parallel. The 100/30/30 DDQN dataset is separate from the defensive evaluation corpora. Across five seeds, final-100-episode goal success reached 93.40% ± 0.55%, and success on the 30-payload DDQN test set was 83.33%. On the 40,978-trial repair corpus, detection increased from 8.26% to 97.39%; all configurations reported an FPR of 0.87% on a separate benign corpus. Full-defense trial-level and payload-level bypass rates were 2.58% and 1.01%, respectively. A further held-out defense evaluation used 32,271 trials derived from 8,438 newly generated source payloads that had not been used to construct the defense. Full defense reduced trial-level bypass from 84.57% to 1.87% and payload-level bypass from 100.00% to 3.98%. Component ablations evaluated generated rules, decoded-only inspection, and dual-path inspection on both corpora. The results demonstrate repair of discovered attacks and provide evidence that defensive effectiveness extends to newly generated payloads withheld from defense construction within the tested environment.

人工智慧語言模型已由單次問答逐步發展為可拆解目標、調用外部工具並長時間執行任務之自主性大型語言模型代理（Autonomous LLM Agents）。若此類架構進入法律服務，風險不僅在於輸出錯誤，更涉及長程行動鏈中的權限越界、錯誤累積、證據保存與責任歸屬。本文比較歐盟《人工智慧法》（EU AI Act）、美國 NIST 風險管理框架及司法專業責任，並檢視我國2026年《人工智慧基本法》及人工智慧風險分類框架，區分具有拘束力之現行義務與待建構之政策建議。本文提出以自主程度、法律影響與行動持續性為核心的風險判斷，建立分級 Agent Logging、人類實質監督、重大依賴之有限揭露，以及模型提供者、系統整合者、部署者與專業使用者四層治理責任模型。進一步藉由假設法律 AI 書狀案例檢驗各主體之注意義務、因果關係及舉證問題，主張以現行契約與侵權責任為起點，循序將技術對齊轉化為可操作、可追溯的法律合規機制。

abstract: 基於擴散模型的生成式淨化已廣泛應用於自動語音辨識（ASR）的對抗防禦。然而，現有評估多以固定攻擊集比較防禦前後的錯誤率，即使採用 BPDA/EOT 作為自適應評估依據，仍不足以判定觀察到的穩健性是否可歸因於所提出的模組，也無法確認自適應攻擊是否正確反映實際防禦流程。本研究提出一套五層實證稽核框架，將白盒穩健性評估分為五個依序相依的問題：表徵效果（L1）、組件歸因（L2）、梯度保真度（L3）、端點攻擊有效性（L4），以及不確定性與報告紀律（L5），各層皆對應最低控制與可支撐的主張範圍。其中兩項語音特有控制為共享完整方法前後端的 Mel-聲碼器往返基準（Mel-Vocoder RoundTrip Baseline，MVRB），以及同隨機性配對下量化的梯度方向保真度。以 MelDefense 為診斷案例，稽核結果顯示，捨棄相位的重合成即可解釋大部分表觀穩健性；在固定非自適應攻擊下，完整擴散管線相較 MVRB 未呈現可偵測增益；在受控算子實驗（n=16 句）中，嚴重的梯度方向失真伴隨46–49 pp 的攻擊低估，而高保真度控制則未出現此現象；以縮減可微代理進行最佳化並轉移至完整防禦後，reduced-surrogate adaptive attack 的防禦後 CER 較 waveform straight-through BPDA 高16.13 個百分點（第二個種子於 10 句子集重現相同趨勢），但其梯度一致性無法判定，且 meldomain BPDA 並未更強。本研究的主要貢獻並非提出新的淨化模型，而是建立一套用於檢驗穩健性主張之可歸因性、攻擊有效性與不確定性控制的評估協定。

abstract: This study proposes an AI-Assisted Adaptive Learning Platform for Chinese Language Comprehensive Assessment Program (CAP) Preparation, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) with the CrewAI multi-agent collaborative architecture. The platform addresses common challenges faced by junior high school students during Chinese language examination preparation, including indiscriminate practice, difficulty in identifying learning weaknesses, and the lack of timely feedback on essay writing, by providing intelligent learning assistance. Based on past Chinese language examination questions from the Comprehensive Assessment Program for Junior High School Students, the system analyzes question types, examination trends, and score distributions, and employs multiple AI agents to collaboratively perform mock examination generation, response analysis, weakness diagnosis, personalized learning recommendations, and real-time essay grading. In this study, 13 students preparing for the CAP were invited to participate in a pre-test and post-test experiment. The results showed that the system achieved an 84.6% hit rate in diagnosing weak question types. After using the system, the participants demonstrated an average improvement of 0.77 grade levels, with 61.5% of the participants achieving an improvement in grade level. For essay grading, the mean absolute error (MAE) between the system's scores and the scoring standards of the CAP Center was 0.417 score levels, with all scoring errors controlled within one score level. Furthermore, the option-generation strategy experiment showed that the improved strategy reduced the answer-uniqueness error rate from 42% to 26% and the format error rate from 22% to 10%. The multi-agent architecture reduced the content omission rate from 31.9% to 0% and shortened the average generation time from 692 seconds to 378 seconds. These results demonstrate that the proposed system provides effective capabilities in weakness diagnosis, targeted learning support, and essay grading, indicating its potential for practical application.

隨著生成式人工智慧與智慧代理人在教育場域的廣泛應用，確保大型語言模型（LLM）具備與人類相符的認知結構與解題穩定性，已成為關鍵挑戰。本研究提出「逆向學習分析」，將受測對象翻轉為AI模型，運用試題反應理論（IRT-2PL）、Rasch模型與Bloom修訂版認知分類，對多模態大型語言模型（F-MLLM，核心為Gemini）在109–114學年度大學入學考試自然科（物理、化學、生物）共18次測驗之作答表現進行量化評估與認知診斷。研究發現：其一，AI雖於潛在能力（θ）評估上穩定達頂標，但其答題正確與否與人類考生之題目難度（P值）呈統計脫鉤；其二，透過認知層次與科學素養分類，精準定位模型於高階評鑑、複雜情境與多步驟推導之學科盲區；其三，以Outfit MNSQ成功捕捉並量化AI類似「粗心失分」或「幻覺」之異常訊號。本研究為AI答題行為提供具可解釋性（XAI）之量化診斷依據，並為智慧教育代理人之校準與審查提出建議。

abstract: 本研究旨在解決構音障礙與失智症語音因資料稀缺與聲學變異導致的辨識瓶頸，評估自監督（SSL）與弱監督模型（Whisper）的泛化潛力。方法上，針對 UASpeech 獨立詞（Isolated Words）與 DementiaBank 連續語音資料集，建構 SSL 兩階段微調系統，並與 Whisper 執行零樣本及全參數微調對比。本論文關鍵發現指出兩範式優勢截然不同：於 UASpeech 中，SSL 基準 HuBERT 獲最佳字錯率（WER）46.98%，優於微調後 Whisper-large-v3 的 51.81%；然於 DementiaBank 中，Whisper-large-v3 微調版以 38.61% 展現優勢，大幅超越 SSL 基準的 67.35%。研究貢獻為實證病理語音架構須依任務選型，獨立詞高度依賴底層聲學表徵，連續語音則受益於語言先驗推理。結論指出極低可懂度語音仍為技術挑戰，未來應結合生成式特徵擴增與參數高效微調（PEFT）技術，以提升系統之次群體強健性（Subpopulation Robustness）並落實臨床公平性。

abstract: 本研究結合可信任人工智慧對話引擎（Trustworthy AI Dialogue Engine, TAIDE）大型語言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的檢索增強生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）回答、人工評分與Quantum Computational Intelligence and Artificial Intelligence（QCI&AI）模糊推論，評估醫療衛教問答。兩位護理學系四年級學生（R1、R2）對741題文字回答的正確性、匹配度、完整性及語言與表達各評分1至5分，共5,928筆評分。四項平均依序為3.89、3.82、3.84、3.56分，語言與表達較低，可優先改善。為評估兩位評分者對相同回答的給分一致程度，本研究採用線性加權Cohen’s κ進行分析。四項評分項目的κ值介於0.218至0.264，顯示評分一致程度仍有提升空間。QCI&AI結合答案語意相似度與人工評分，並計算系統判定的等級與部分輸入評分的平均值所換算的等級相同的比例，R1、R2原為85.8%、89.7%。以基因演算法（Genetic Algorithm, GA）及粒子群最佳化演算法（Particle Swarm Optimization, PSO）調整參數後，R1採GA達94.7%，R2採PSO達97.6%。人工評分結果可供後續重新檢查回答內容；模糊推論結果則反映此批資料的等級匹配情形，尚不能證明模型能獨立判斷回答品質，或在其他題目上有相同表現。

abstract: 隨著大型語言模型的發展，自然語言處理的效能已顯著提升。然而，其仍面臨高計算成本與高硬體需求等挑戰。混合專家模型（Mixture of Experts, MoE）能在固定計算成本下擴展模型容量，因而有效降低這些需求。MoE 模型相較於具相同計算複雜度的密集模型，具有更高的記憶體需求，進而導致專家冗餘與有效容量低等問題。本研究旨在透過分析訓練期間各專家的激活頻率，判定專家對模型的重要性，並據此調整其參數。激活頻率作為縮放因子，可擴大高頻率專家並縮小低頻率專家，以最佳化模型的資源配置。於 SQuAD資料集上的測試結果顯示，三種BERT模型經雙向縮放後的準確率均略微提升，但部分F1分數有所下降。僅縮減參數的策略則可減少約17%至42%的參數量，同時維持或略微提升BERT模型效能。然而，GPT-2模型在兩種縮放策略下的準確率均略微下降。實驗結果顯示，本方法具有減少模型參數冗餘的潛力，但其效能改善仍因模型架構而異，未來需進一步驗證其資源效率與泛化能力。

本研究提出一套以結構化 Prompt 為核心的多輪適性評量題目生成流程。系統依教材建立核心概念與知識點，生成含診斷式誘答的起始題目（BQ），並將各誘答對應至可能錯誤理解與追問策略，再據此產生後續追問題（FQ）。題目於施測前經生成、審查與重新生成流程後納入題庫。期末施測共 124 位學生、985 筆有效 BQ 題次，初答正確率為 61.52%，追問與重答後最終正確率為 73.50%；初答錯誤題次中，31.13% 於追問後改答正確。結果顯示，本流程可依學生實際錯誤選項提供差異化追問；由於本次未設無 FQ 控制組，相關結果僅作描述性解讀。

Study-abroad advising draws on official requirements, community-reported experiences, and faculty research information, which differ in authority and structure. Retrieval-augmented generation ranks evidence by relevance, yet a relevant community report about a GPA threshold is not an official requirement. Our insight is that source authority should shape retrieval routing, not be considered only after retrieval. We present a source-aware agentic RAG system built with LangGraph that routes official requirements to text-to-SQL, experience questions to retrieval over community reports, and faculty questions to query-time search; a bounded evidence check allows one retry and otherwise abstains. On 34 official-data queries at five universities, the system answered all correctly; on 60 threshold questions for 20 universities without indexed official data, it abstained on all and gave no unsupported numerical threshold, whereas a ReAct baseline with different prompting and answer model gave one for 55%. An ablation attributes this mainly to intent-based routing rather than the evidence check. The adversarial set does not test over-refusal or source conflicts.

刑事案件的對話紀錄數量龐大且脈絡分散，又常夾雜代稱與錯字。本文提出以檢索增強生成（RAG）整理線索的流程。流程以單則訊息作為引用與稽核單位，以同一聊天室的連續訊息作為檢索脈絡，再透過主張與證據對照及人工檢核限制模型推論。原型已在一件案件的數位證物工作複本上完成功能展示，並以去識別化的真實對話進行前導測試。量化評估使用220則合成對話與32道標註題目，比較BM25、BGE-M3向量與兩者融合的檢索，並以qwen3:8b評估受限生成。三種檢索方法的Top-5關鍵訊息找回率為0.833、0.667與0.792，代稱題為0.250至0.500。生成結果沒有超出取回範圍的引用，應拒答題的拒答率為0.875至1.000，三次重複輸出完全相同。代稱與暗語查詢仍需搭配偵查人員的經驗判讀。

abstract: 預測學生學業表現是教育資料探勘的重要目標之一，可協助及早辨識可能需要額外支援的學生，並提供資料驅動的教育決策資訊。本研究應用資料探勘技術預測學生學業表現，並辨識與分類結果具有較高關聯性的特徵。研究以學生行為與學業資料為基礎，在 RapidMiner 中建立決策樹模型，並使用 Optuna 進行超參數優化。資料集被劃分為相互獨立的訓練集與測試集，超參數優化僅於訓練集上透過 10 折交叉驗證進行。優化後模型在獨立測試集上的準確率為 68.42%，相較於 RapidMiner 預設模型的 65.26%，提升 3.16 個百分點。特徵重要性分析顯示，Visited Resources 與 Discussion 為最具影響力的預測特徵，其次為 Announcements View 與 Raised Hands。結果顯示，超參數優化可使決策樹分類效能獲得小幅改善，並顯示學生使用學習資源與課堂互動等行為特徵對學業表現預測具有重要性。

abstract: 本研究提出一套以強弱人工智慧決策差異驅動的適應式五子棋教學系統。強AI採用Policy-Value Network搭配Monte Carlo Tree Search（MCTS），弱AI採用深度3之Alpha-Beta Minimax與棋型評估。兩者的走法會以400次搜尋預算的MCTS統一重新評估並計算分數差距；若分數損失超過門檻且玩家在該局面下的走法不屬於可接受集合時會觸發提示；此時系統會將程式辨識的棋型和強AI的推薦座標等盤面資訊交由大型語言模型產生說明。實驗驗證則由20位參與者完成3個主題共10題的問卷，主題分別為提示時機、教學內容與整體知覺效用，平均分數分別為4.25、3.90與4.07，十題總平均為4.06。結果顯示參與者肯定系統的提示時機、教學內容與整體教學價值。

abstract: 親密暴力問卷的無監督分析面臨題項依存關係、缺乏真實群體標籤與小樣本等問題。本文提出結合題項關聯表徵、深度分群與注意力導向資料擴增的架構：先將 30題、0–4分的問卷轉換為三種30×30題項關聯矩陣，再以Encoder–Decoder建立低維表徵，並結合KL散度、群內一致性與群間差異性損失進行分群；最後以分群結果訓練分類器，利用 Grad-CAM 找出重要的題項關聯區域並產生擴增資料。實驗使用 180 份訓練資料、2,831 份線上測試資料與 331份由專業輔導員協助填寫的測試資料。結果顯示，注意力導向資料擴增在多數設定下提升平均 Cronbach’s alpha，但效果仍受題項關聯表示與資料分布影響。
